note: Field Group Table adds one Field Group formatter plugin id 'field_group_table' (label 'Table', supported_contexts form+view) that renders a group's fields as a 2-column label/value table. Requires the field_group module. It has no config entity/route/permissions/Drush of its own; the group is stored by field_group in the entity display config third_party_settings.field_group.<group_name> with format_type=field_group_table and a format_settings map (label_visibility[1 hidden/2 above/3 caption/4 below], desc, desc_visibility, first_column, second_column, empty_label_behavior[1 keep/2 merge], table_row_striping, always_show_field_label, always_show_field_value, empty_field_placeholder, hide_table_if_empty). It invites one hook, hook_field_group_table_rows_alter(&$element,&$children). Medium cases read a group's live config off node.article default view display; hard cases create/configure such a group verified against that display config.

evals.prompt: What does the field_group_table module add to Drupal, what is the group format's plugin id, and how does it render the fields in a group?
evals.expected_output: It adds a Field Group formatter with plugin id 'field_group_table' (label 'Table') that renders each field in the group as a row of a 2-column table: the field label in the left column and the rendered field value in the right. Requires the field_group module.

evals.prompt: Can the field_group_table 'Table' group format be used on entity edit forms, on view displays, or both?
evals.expected_output: Both. The plugin declares supported_contexts = {form, view}, so you can pick 'Table' as a field group format on both Manage form display and Manage display.

evals.prompt: Name some of the format settings the field_group_table 'Table' group offers, e.g. how do I add column headers or show a row for a field that is empty?
evals.expected_output: Settings include first_column/second_column (column header text), label_visibility (hidden/above/caption/below), empty_label_behavior (keep vs merge cells), table_row_striping, always_show_field_label, always_show_field_value plus empty_field_placeholder (force a row for an empty field), and hide_table_if_empty. To add column headers set first_column/second_column; to show empty fields enable always_show_field_value and set empty_field_placeholder.

evals.prompt: On this site the Article content type's default view display has a field group named 'group_fgt_known'. Inspect the display configuration and tell me which field group format (format_type) that group uses.
evals.expected_output: It uses format_type 'field_group_table' (the Table format). Read core.entity_view_display.node.article.default third_party_settings.field_group.group_fgt_known.format_type.

evals.prompt: On this site, the Article default view display has a field_group_table group named 'group_fgt_hdr'. Inspect the live display config and tell me the text configured as its second column header.
evals.expected_output: The second column header (format_settings.second_column) is 'Reading'. Read core.entity_view_display.node.article.default third_party_settings.field_group.group_fgt_hdr.format_settings.second_column.

evals.prompt: On this site, on the Article content type's default view display, add a Field Group named 'group_fgt_task' that uses the field_group_table 'Table' format. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Add a field_group group 'group_fgt_task' with format_type 'field_group_table' to core.entity_view_display.node.article.default (third_party_settings.field_group.group_fgt_task), e.g. via the Manage display field-group UI or $display->setThirdPartySetting('field_group','group_fgt_task',[...'format_type'=>'field_group_table'...])->save().

evals.prompt: On the Article default view display, add a field_group_table 'Table' field group named 'group_fgt_cfg' whose first column header is 'Field' and which has table row striping (zebra striping) enabled. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Add group 'group_fgt_cfg' with format_type 'field_group_table' and format_settings first_column='Field', table_row_striping=true on core.entity_view_display.node.article.default (third_party_settings.field_group.group_fgt_cfg).
